system.description:
A defensive school of the Jinia Isles' harbour towns and back alleys: counter-attack, misdirection, and an opponent's aggression turned against them.

  • Serpent's Guard: you have Advantage on Parry checks (meeting the attack roll already succeeds).
    • 9th level: when your Parry succeeds, the attacker has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
  • Read the Blade: Advantage on Tumbling checks on unsteady footing (decks, rooftops, rope bridges) and on Insight checks to read an opponent's style mid-fight.
